name: BetterDiscord Plugins
description: Runs BetterDiscord plugins (.plugin.js files) inside Amiricord. Only plugins that were bundled into this build by its owners are run; nothing is downloaded or read from your disk. This layer is always on, but it runs nothing by itself: every BetterDiscord plugin has its own switch in this plugin's settings and is off until you switch it on. A BetterDiscord plugin can do anything a plugin of Amiricord can (it is not limited by permissions), so switch on only the ones you trust.

credits.name: BetterDiscord, the plugin format and the BdApi it documents (no code copied)
